platformScope.label: U.S. outdoor dashboard
platformScope.detail: Live weather, sun, and moon use your coordinates. Nature, wildlife, trails, and water sections show educational U.S. field guidance — not county-specific ecology until a local bundle is available.

platformMission.lead: Your outdoor dashboard — observe, understand, and plan field time anywhere in the United States.
platformMission.pillars: Live conditions at your coordinates · Educational field guidance · Honest labels for every layer
platformMission.honest: Regional species timing and trail alerts require a local content bundle. Until then, educational panels help you investigate safely and ethically.

thisWeekOutdoors.title: Outdoor conditions at your location
thisWeekOutdoors.summary: Weather, daylight, and safety use live data for your latitude and longitude. Wildlife, plants, trails, and water guidance below are educational — useful nationwide, not local species lists.
